div.div: مَآوِدُ Calamities: (IAar, M, L, K:) as also مَوَائِدُ, which is app. formed by transposition. (M, L.) Some say that مآود is pl. of مُؤْيِدٌ, and derive this word [which see in art. ايد] from آدَهُ, aor. يَؤُودٌ, meaning “ it oppressed him by its weight: ” (T, L:) or it has no sing. (IAar, M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
